_comment: Hand-authored. The corridor start / launch flight, bank 7 $F282-$F46E. The generator for 20-traced.json subtracts these.

regions.name: Corridor start: blank the screen, then choose
regions.description: Called by JSR $EC99 in the corridor loader ($EC8C/$EC94), which has read the corridor number from the room record, so bank 5 is live here. $EDD1 FADES the display to black: the 24 saved palette bytes $04D0-$04E7 and the backdrop $0180 are set to black and $EDBD steps the fade ($D950) every two frames until it is done (8 frames in the run), then interrupts off and rendering off ($D4C7: $A3 = 0, PPUMASK bits 3-4 cleared); $D4E3 clears the NMI-enable bit of PPUCTRL. Then: corridor 0 or 22 go to the short path at $F290; every other corridor goes on to $F2A0. (Entry points inside this routine - $F2BB, $F2D9, $F336, $F43C, $F452 - are used by the stage-clear code too.)

regions.name: No flight: load the launch sprites and go straight on
regions.description: Taken by corridors 0 and 22 and by EVERY corridor of a TGL game (from $F2AE), so those never see the launch scene: $0680 = 0, $F6E5 loads the ship's sprite sheet (the decompressor armed with block 5 of bank 2 for PPU $0000), sprite 0's y is set to $BF (191, the HUD split) and it jumps to the tail at $F452. RUN: corridors 0 and 22, and all 23 TGL corridors, reached $F290; corridors 1-21 of a normal game reached $F2B4.

regions.name: The HUD's area number: fold the corridor onto the labyrinth
regions.description: $50 = the corridor folded onto the labyrinth's 1-10: 11-20 give 1-10 (CMP #$0B / SBC #$0A) and 21 is capped at 10. This is how leaving a corridor 'sets the area' (the labyrinth's HUD prints $50).

regions.name: TGL games skip the flight
regions.description: $30 bit 1 set (the TGL game) branches back to $F290.

regions.name: Launch jingle
regions.description: Plays sound $1D ($D852). The sound's identity was not looked up.

regions.name: Set the mode, load the launch sprites and the common scenes
regions.description: $F2B9 loads A = 0 and $F2BB stores A in $0680 - slot 0's field 16, used here as the MODE: 0 = taking off (the entry from $F2B9), 1 = landing (the stage-clear code at $F6BE jumps into $F2BB with A = 1). Then $F6E5 (the launch sprite sheet), $30 |= $48 (corridor mode and bit 3), and the bank 5 scene loader $8000 twice with A = 0 and A = $20: the two common scenes 0 and 32 (the blue panel tunnel, the same for every corridor), then waits for the decompressor ($D7C3) and switches to bank 4. HARNESS LESSON: the loader calls $8000 in the LIVE bank, so bank 5 must be live (as it is when $EC8C has just read the map record); from a savestate whose bank is 6 the call lands in bank 6, far-calls the ship's handler and bumps $0680, which made every start look like mode 1.

regions.name: Choose and start the flight's screen-data block
regions.description: A = $FF; only when $0680 is not 0 AND the corridor is 21 does it play sound $2D and use A = $FE. Bank 4's entry ($8000 -> $8003) takes entry number A + 2 of its pointer table: $FF -> entry 1 = $81ED (the flight block: scroll speed $0600 at once = 6 px a frame, a background row table, a palette list, three overlay records, no enemy wave), $FE -> entry 0 = $826D (a longer block: speed $0400 and then $1000). So entry 1 serves both modes and corridors 1-20; entry 0 would be used only when landing from corridor 21, which the stage-clear code does not appear to reach (a LEAD). $E560 and $E5BD then start the stream engine on that block exactly as for a corridor. The parser calls these table entries 'area -2' and 'area -1'.

regions.name: The flight's ship: a type-$05 object in slot 0
regions.description: Slot 0 becomes type $05 with tile base $06C8 = 0, drawing flags $0620 = 1, target $0668 = 0 and thrust $0788 = 0. Mode 0: y = $30, y velocity +0.5 px a frame ($05D8 = 0, $05C0 = $80). Mode 1: y = $C8, velocity -0.25 ($05D8 = $FF, $05C0 = $C0). x = $80. RUN: corridors 1-21 of a normal game all gave y 48, velocity 0 . $80 at this point (the end of the routine's set-up).

regions.name: Reset the animation phase and switch the display on
regions.description: $CD99 clears the phase counter ($0638 whole, $0650 fraction), then A = $BF (sprite 0's y) and $EDE5: the sprite-0 set-up ($D51E), $05 and $4010 = $87 (the DMC rate), a wait for the vblank edges, NMI on ($D4F3), two frames' wait, rendering on ($D4D5), interrupts on.

regions.name: Flight loop: scroll, reset the sprites, pick the mode
regions.description: $E66A is the scroll step with the speed ramp (the stage step's speed code: $E530, then $B8/$B9 moved toward the target $BA/$BB), $CDB4 resets the sprite allocator, X = 0 (the ship), and $0680 = 0 branches to the mode-0 motion at $F3A7, otherwise it continues with the mode-1 motion.

regions.name: Landing (mode 1): the ship's pose and thrust from the phase
regions.description: Corridor 21: the y fraction $05C0 is set to $C4 and pose 1 is held (the phase is not advanced). Other corridors: the phase advances by $80 per frame while it is below $3C and by $60 after ($CD7A, wrapping at $C8). Phase below $60: the pose cycles through $F47B[phase mod 12] (ids 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 6 5 4 3 2; $F9AE is an 8-bit division, Y = Y mod A) with the attribute $F487 (bit 6 = flipped for the middle poses), no thrust. $60 to $6B: ids 1, 2, 3, 4, then 14, 15 ... 21 read backwards from $F46F, attribute $40, thrust $0788 = 8 (accelerating up through $CD12). From $6C: id 22, thrust 8. RUN, mode 1: ids 3, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 6, 5 ... from frame 79 at y 200 rising 0.25 px a frame, then the big shapes at the end; the ship leaves the top at frame 386.

regions.name: Take-off (mode 0): the ship's pose and thrust from the phase
regions.description: The phase steps by $30 while it is below $22 and by $60 from then on. Phase below 10: pose 22. 10-18: ids 22 down to 14 ($F46F[phase - 10]) then 4, 3, 2 (phases 19-21). From 22 to 69: $F47B[(phase - 10) mod 12] with the attribute $F487. From $46: pose 1 held. From phase $40 the thrust $0788 = $20 and the ship accelerates upward through $CD12 with that value (target y = 0 in $0668). RUN, mode 0: ids 22 (frames 26-84), 21 ... 14 (84-127), 4 3 2 1, then 2 ... 7 ... 1 repeating; y 48 -> 172 at +0.5 a frame, thrust $20 from frame ~285, off the top at frame 344.

regions.name: Draw the ship and its flame, then loop or leave
regions.description: $CBE8 draws object 0 (it returns carry set once the ship has left the screen). While the ship is rising ($05D8 negative) and its pose is below 14 it also draws metasprite $1D (the exhaust flame) with tile base $32 or $34 by bit 1 of the frame counter $41. $CE88 finishes the sprites. The loop ends when the ship is gone, or when SELECT IS HELD with no new press: $F493 handles a NEW Start (pause) or Select (the status screen), then $F7 bit 5 (Select held) exits. Otherwise one frame's wait ($FFD1 with Y = 1) and back to $F33E. RUN: a Select tap opens the status screen inside the scene (frame 60) and a second tap closes it and the scene resumes and ends later (413, not 344); Select held from before the scene starts leaves at the first pass (frame 26).

regions.name: Leave the flight: mode 0 loads the corridor's sprites and returns
regions.description: $EDD1 fades the screen to black and $F43C ($D755: bank 5) is also the entry the corridor-0 stage-clear code uses. Mode 1 goes to $F458. Mode 0: $30 bit 3 cleared, a 20-frame wait, the NMI off, then (also the target of $F290's shortcut) $F717 and $F705, which arm the decompressor for further sprite tiles from bank 2 (a block to PPU $0680 and one chosen from the selected weapon $3C in $F717, block $0C to $0740 in $F705; not read through) and wait for it ($D7C3); their return is this routine's return to $EC9C, where $EF6C begins the corridor proper. RUN: the exit at frame 344, the tail at 372.

regions.name: Leave the landing: back to the labyrinth's sprites
regions.description: Mode 1's tail: $30 bits 3 and 4 cleared, the first two bytes of slot 0's hit box ($06E0, $06F8) zeroed, and unless it is a TGL game $F6F5 loads the labyrinth ship's sprite sheet (bank 2 block 4 for PPU $0000) before $F717. Reached from the stage-clear code at $F6BE (a normal game, through the whole landing flight) and at $F659-$F664 (corridor 0's end, which jumps to $F43C and so skips the flight).
